Messages.Body:
Oortje4ever wrote:
> If an anarch already has a title, can it still get a fire brand?

Sure, as long as the anarch doesn't already have a firebrand. Card
text: "Called by any anarch"

> When can I burn the blood to untap a younger anarch with fire brand?
> During a referendum, after strike anounce ment, when you become blocked?
> Or between actions?

Anytime during your minion phase, including during an action or combat
or what not.

(See also: Alexandra's special)

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Oortje4ever wrote:
> something simelar...
>
> can Kephamos, High Priest of Marrakech has 2 votes (by card text),
> become an anarch with "go anarch"? does the 2 votes count as a title?

No. Yes.

> If so, why does the 1 vote from firebrand not count as a title?

"1 vote" and "2 votes" are titles. I could look the section up in the
rulebook, but I'm too lazy.

"Additional votes" are not titles; eg, merged Jan Pieterzoon ("...3
additional votes") is not a title. Firebrand falls into this category.
They're not titles because otherwise they'd replace the existing
votes, and so could never be "additional"; eg, if Firebrand was a title,
then a Baron of LA who became Firebrand would no longer be a Baron.
This is not the case.

> Is liason a title?

Yes, by card text ("Liaison is a unique Independent title")

> If so, does the title only give votes while "Rise of the Nephtali" is
> in play? So if the "Rise of the Nephtali" is burned, is liasoned
> vampire still a liason whitout votes?
> Or does he/she loses the title?

I could be completely wrong here; this is just my opinion now: I'd be
inclined to say the vampire keeps the Liaison title, and now no one else
can try to get it (similar to old Archon: the card didn't stay in play,
but the abilities granted did).

--Colin McGuigan
